issues.description: Wrong screen is showing. The app is redirecting to /auth instead of rendering /design/step-7c. The URL shows 'http://localhost:3000/auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-7c' meaning the step-7c route requires authentication and is redirecting unauthenticated users to the auth page.
issues.element: Entire page - showing auth screen instead of step-7c Keep/Remove screen
issues.root_cause: The /design/step-7c route has an authentication guard/middleware that redirects unauthenticated users to /auth. The page at apps/web/app/design/step-7c/page.tsx likely uses a session/auth check that triggers a redirect. The middleware or page-level auth check sees no valid session and redirects to /auth with next=/design/step-7c as query param.

issues.description: Console logs show 'page:mount' event firing with page='auth' multiple times (6 times across 4 page loads), and a 400 error from a failed resource load. The step-7c page is never mounted, confirming the auth redirect is blocking access.
issues.element: Console logs showing repeated auth page mounts and a 400 error
issues.root_cause: The 400 error is likely from an auth API call (e.g., Supabase token refresh or session validation) failing. The middleware at apps/web/middleware.ts or the page-level auth check in apps/web/app/design/step-7c/page.tsx is enforcing auth and redirecting.
